draftLineArchitectures.name: Standard Braided Flexible Vinyl (Plasticized PVC, DEHP/DINP, NSF 51 Only)
draftLineArchitectures.biofilmAdhesionIndex: Critical (Porosity and plasticizer bloom create extensive micro-cavity anchor sites)
draftLineArchitectures.cipChemicalResistance: Poor (Degrades with caustic NaOH >2% and peracetic acid; turns yellow and embrittles)
draftLineArchitectures.fdaFoodContactApproval: NON-COMPLIANT for pressurized dairy/nitro draft lines under NSF/ANSI 18 § 5.2
draftLineArchitectures.plasticizerMigrationRisk: High (Lipids in coffee crema and milk extract ortho-phthalate plasticizers)
draftLineArchitectures.description: Ubiquitous entry-level clear beverage tubing. Highly flexible due to phthalate plasticizers. Over time, warm sanitizers and coffee acids leach plasticizers, creating microscopic interior fissures (crazing) that shelter bacterial pioneer colonies from chemical flow shear.

draftLineArchitectures.name: Multi-Layer EVOH Barrier Draft Line (Ultra-Smooth PE Core, EVOH Oxygen Barrier)
draftLineArchitectures.biofilmAdhesionIndex: Very Low (Mirror-smooth hydrophobic lumen inhibits initial bacterial adherence)
draftLineArchitectures.cipChemicalResistance: Excellent (Impervious to alkaline cleaners, peracetic acid, and phosphoric acid descalers)
draftLineArchitectures.plasticizerMigrationRisk: Zero (100% plasticizer-free unplasticized polyolefin polymer matrix)
draftLineArchitectures.description: Modern specialty coffee draft tubing engineered with an ultra-smooth polyethylene food contact layer backed by an EVOH gas barrier. Effectively blocks ambient oxygen migration, preventing aerobic bacterial colonization and fungal pellicle formation.

draftLineArchitectures.name: Electropolished 316L Stainless Steel Trunk Line (Commercial Dairy/Beverage Grade)
draftLineArchitectures.biofilmAdhesionIndex: Ultra-Low (Passive chromium oxide layer prevents microbial adhesion)
draftLineArchitectures.cipChemicalResistance: Maximum (Withstands 85°C caustic cycles, concentrated ozone, steam sterilization, and PAA)
draftLineArchitectures.fdaFoodContactApproval: FULL SANITARY CERTIFICATION (NSF/ANSI Standard 18 & 3-A Sanitary Standards)
draftLineArchitectures.plasticizerMigrationRisk: Zero (Inorganic metallic alloy with zero organic extracts)
draftLineArchitectures.description: Commercial stadium and high-throughput café permanent trunk line installation. Features mirror-polished internal lumen (Ra < 0.04 µm) with zero gas permeability. Supports aggressive hot chemical CIP regimens and high hydraulic flow velocities that shear away incipient biofilms.

draftLineArchitectures.name: Aged / Degraded Vinyl Line (>6 Months Continuous Service, Calcified Micro-Cracks)
draftLineArchitectures.materialClass: Embrittled Hydrolyzed Plasticized PVC with Microbial Bio-Slime
draftLineArchitectures.biofilmAdhesionIndex: Catastrophic (Deep fissures harbor mature irreversible multi-species polysaccharide matrix)
draftLineArchitectures.cipChemicalResistance: Exhausted (Chemical sanitizers fail to penetrate >50 µm thick EPS slime mantle)
draftLineArchitectures.fdaFoodContactApproval: IMMINENT HEALTH HAZARD (FDA Food Code § 4-402.11 Spoilage & Pathogen Harborage)
draftLineArchitectures.plasticizerMigrationRisk: Extreme (Severe chemical leaching and off-flavor taint in dispensed coffee)
draftLineArchitectures.description: Neglected draft line displaying cloudiness, yellowing, or black fungal flecks inside the wall. Internal surfaces exhibit microscopic pitting and deep grooving where extracellular polymeric substances (EPS) create an impenetrable defensive matrix protecting Pseudomonas, Acetobacter, and mold spores.

draftLineArchitectures.name: Medical/Pharma-Grade Fluoropolymer (PTFE/FEP) Lined Nitrogen Tubing
draftLineArchitectures.biofilmAdhesionIndex: Negligible (Extremely low surface energy prevents cellular adhesion)
draftLineArchitectures.cipChemicalResistance: Complete (Inert to all culinary disinfectants, autoclaving, and caustic detergents)
draftLineArchitectures.fdaFoodContactApproval: COMPLIANT (FDA 21 CFR § 177.1550 & USP Class VI Medical Standards)
draftLineArchitectures.plasticizerMigrationRisk: Zero (Chemically inert fluoropolymer with non-stick lumen)
draftLineArchitectures.description: Premium industrial-grade draft line utilizing a non-stick fluoropolymer liner. Eliminates coffee oil and diterpene adhesion, preventing flavor carryover and offering maximum hygiene in low-flow specialty nitro installations.

operatingTemperatures.name: 3°C (37.4°F) - Optimal Commercial Walk-In Kegerator (Gold Standard)
operatingTemperatures.typicalSetup: Properly balanced glycol-chilled trunk line running directly to cold tap

operatingTemperatures.name: 8°C (46.4°F) - Inadequately Chilled Long-Draw Line / Warm Glycol Bath
operatingTemperatures.typicalSetup: Uninsulated draft chase, underpowered glycol power pack, or warm dispenser shanks

operatingTemperatures.name: 18°C (64.4°F) - Unchilled Countertop Draft Tower / Ambient Bar Environment
operatingTemperatures.growthPhase: Exponential Growth Phase (Active slime secretion & fermentation)
operatingTemperatures.typicalSetup: Countertop nitro coffee box without tower cold-air recirculation ducting

operatingTemperatures.name: 25°C (77.0°F) - Hot Summer Stagnant Overnight Tower (Mesophilic Danger Zone)
operatingTemperatures.growthPhase: Explosive Logarithmic Growth (Rapid acid souring & fungal pellicles)
operatingTemperatures.typicalSetup: Overnight closed coffee shop with AC turned off; coffee sitting stagnant inside tap shank

stagnationDutyCycles.name: High-Throughput Rush (Pour Every 2–5 Minutes; Continuous Flow Shear)
stagnationDutyCycles.attachmentOpportunity: Very Low (High fluid velocity scours loose pioneer bacteria)
stagnationDutyCycles.description: Continuous dispensing keeps coffee moving. Fluid shear stress detaches unanchored cells before extracellular polysaccharide polymer chains can crosslink to the tube lumen.

stagnationDutyCycles.name: Moderate Café Pace (Pour Every 30–60 Minutes; Intermittent Stagnation)
stagnationDutyCycles.attachmentOpportunity: Moderate (Temporary quiescence permits bacterial flagellar anchoring)
stagnationDutyCycles.description: Standard specialty café flow. Quiescent intervals between customer orders allow pioneer bacteria to secrete initial adhesive glycoproteins onto tubing walls.

stagnationDutyCycles.name: Overnight Idle Stagnation (8–12 Hours Closed; Complete Fluid Quiescence)
stagnationDutyCycles.attachmentOpportunity: High (Biofilm maturation, EPS consolidation, oxygen scavenging)
stagnationDutyCycles.description: Nightly shutdown. Stagnant coffee in unchilled draft lines facilitates rapid bacterial micro-colony development and anaerobic metabolite production.

stagnationDutyCycles.name: Weekend Long-Holiday Idle (48–72 Hours Stagnant in Line)
stagnationDutyCycles.attachmentOpportunity: Critical / Hazardous (Irreversible multi-tier biofilm with fungal hyphae network)
stagnationDutyCycles.description: Prolonged holiday closure without line purging. Biofilm reaches mature climax community status; mold hyphae penetrate tubing crevices and gas check valves.

gasAtmospheres.name: 100% Pure Food-Grade Nitrogen (N2) at 45 PSI (Microaerophilic / Anaerobic)
gasAtmospheres.cascadeMicroFoamQuality: Silky Dense Velvet Cascade (Standard Nitro Cold Brew)
gasAtmospheres.description: Pure food-grade nitrogen (99.998% purity). Displaces dissolved oxygen, inhibiting strict aerobic molds while allowing lactic acid bacteria and facultative anaerobes to survive if temperature exceeds 8°C.

gasAtmospheres.name: Beer Gas Blend (75% N2 / 25% CO2) at 38 PSI (Mild Acidic Carbonic Barrier)
gasAtmospheres.cascadeMicroFoamQuality: Creamy Head with Slight Carbonic Effervescence
gasAtmospheres.description: Guinness-style nitrogen/carbon dioxide blend. Dissolved CO2 forms mild carbonic acid, lowering coffee pH by 0.2–0.4 units, exerting an inhibitory bacteriostatic effect against Pseudomonas.

gasAtmospheres.name: Unfiltered Shop Compressor Ambient Air at 30 PSI (Aerobic Hazard Seeding)
gasAtmospheres.cascadeMicroFoamQuality: Coarse Bubbles, Rapid Separation, Premature Staling
gasAtmospheres.description: Dangerous cost-cutting measure using shop air. 21% oxygen supercharges fungal growth and aerobic bacteria, while airborne oil aerosols and particulates directly contaminate the beverage.

gasAtmospheres.name: 100% Nitrous Oxide (N2O) Infusion at 50 PSI (Super-Creamy High-Solubility)
gasAtmospheres.cascadeMicroFoamQuality: Ultra-Dense Dessert Micro-Foam with Sweet Aromatic Lift
gasAtmospheres.description: Nitrous oxide provides high liquid solubility and enhanced sweetness. High head pressure strains line connections and valve elastomeric O-rings.

cipSanitizationProtocols.name: Professional Dual-Stage CIP (Caustic Wash + Peracetic Acid Sanitize every 14 Days)
cipSanitizationProtocols.sanitizerType: 2% Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH) at 60°C followed by 0.2% Peracetic Acid (PAA)
cipSanitizationProtocols.epsDisruptionCapability: Complete (Dissolves crosslinked polysaccharides and sloughs biofilm)
cipSanitizationProtocols.nsfCompliance: COMPLIANT (Full compliance with NSF/ANSI Standard 18 & Brewers Association Draught Manual)
cipSanitizationProtocols.description: Industry gold standard. The warm alkaline wash strips coffee oils, polyphenols, and dissolves the EPS matrix, while the peracetic acid rinse destroys spores, molds, and bacteria.

cipSanitizationProtocols.name: Single-Stage Chlorinated Cleaner Rinse (Monthly Flush)
cipSanitizationProtocols.sanitizerType: Chlorinated Alkaline Beverage Line Cleaner (Cold Cycle)
cipSanitizationProtocols.epsDisruptionCapability: Moderate (Breaks surface bio-burden but leaves basal anchor cells)
cipSanitizationProtocols.nsfCompliance: BORDERLINE (Exceeds recommended 14-day service interval; risk of chlorophenol off-flavors)
cipSanitizationProtocols.description: Common but suboptimal. Kills unshielded bacteria, but residual chlorine can bind to coffee polyphenols generating medicinal chlorophenol off-notes. Inadequate frequency allows EPS layers to rebound.

cipSanitizationProtocols.name: Water-Only Flush (Warm Tap Water Run, No Chemical Detergent)
cipSanitizationProtocols.epsDisruptionCapability: Zero (Removes loose coffee solids but hydrates and feeds existing biofilm)
cipSanitizationProtocols.nsfCompliance: NON-COMPLIANT (Violates FDA Food Code § 4-602.11 for beverage dispensing equipment)
cipSanitizationProtocols.description: Ineffective domestic shortcut. Rinsing with plain water does not dissolve lipids or bacterial polysaccharides. Instead, warm water without biocide induces heat-shock stress in microbes, triggering thicker EPS secretion.

cipSanitizationProtocols.name: Neglected / Overdue Maintenance (>60 Days Without Chemical Cleaning)
cipSanitizationProtocols.epsDisruptionCapability: Zero (Mature multi-species biofilm with calcified mineral beerstone/coffeestone)
cipSanitizationProtocols.nsfCompliance: CRITICAL HEALTH HAZARD (Imminent risk of gastrointestinal illness and mold toxin ingestion)
cipSanitizationProtocols.description: Severely neglected draft lines. Thick, slime-laden biofilm continuously sheds living pathogens and endotoxins into customer glasses. Requires complete line replacement or chemical shock-stripping.

coffeeSubstrates.name: Pure Black Cold Brew (Medium Roast, Filtered <5 µm, pH 5.1, 1.8% Soluble Solids)
coffeeSubstrates.description: Standard black cold brew coffee. Low lipid content, but chlorogenic acids and trace polysaccharides provide carbon sources for acid-tolerant bacteria.

coffeeSubstrates.name: Ready-to-Drink Nitro Oat / Dairy Milk Latte (pH 6.3, 3.5% Fat, 5% Sugar)
coffeeSubstrates.description: Extremely high-risk substrate. Higher pH (near neutral 6.3) combined with proteins, dairy sugars, and emulsified fats creates ideal incubator broth for rapid spoilage and pathogen colonization.

coffeeSubstrates.name: Sweetened Chicory / Vanilla Cold Brew (pH 4.8, 0.4% Fat, 8% Added Sugars)
coffeeSubstrates.description: High sucrose and fructose content supports rapid osmophilic yeast fermentation, producing ethanol, carbon dioxide gas pockets, and sour vinegar off-flavors.

presets.name: Overdue Vinyl Line in Busy Café with Warm Tower Stagnation (Severe Microbial Risk)
NSF/ANSI 18 Certified Stainless Trunk with Bi-Weekly PAA CIP (Gold Master Standard)
Draft Oat Milk Latte Left in Tap Line Over Long Weekend (Catastrophic Spoilage)
